correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the uniform first split gives the standard recursion. The harmonic increment formula proves monotonicity; finite harmonic/power sums cancel to the cubic covariance and the centered-square uniform statistic gives Var(Q). Independent exhaustive replay over all permutations for n=3,…,7 matched the covariance; the frozen verifier extends exact checks through n=9 and harmonic identities through n=400.
